metric: HH seasonal standard deviation relative to the median of five reference-forest means (dB)
source: NISAR GCOV HH native power, masked and averaged to 30 m; adjacent frames 069/070 on track 133 descending

properties.basis: Smallest symmetric metric buffer covering all five existing image footprints, rounded up to 1 km.
properties.source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), inherited approximate military demarcation line

properties.basis: Smallest symmetric metric buffer covering all five existing image footprints, rounded up to 1 km.
properties.source: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), inherited approximate military demarcation line

processing.multilook: 3x3 mean of finite positive power with product mask 1..254
processing.smoothing: 5x5 mean of valid 30 m linear power, retaining the centre-cell validity
processing.reference: Median of the five per-region reference-forest linear-power means converted to dB, one shared scalar per date
processing.standard_deviation: Population standard deviation; only actual observed dates; minimum 2 observations
processing.display_grid: EPSG:3857, 80 projected meters (about 63 ground meters); area-average resampling of linear power before dB
processing.edge_tiles: 1024x1024 with transparent padding; padding has no observations or numerical values
processing.overlaps: Use valid frame 069 cells first; frame 070 fills missing cells on the same date
processing.nodata: Transparent; no gap filling, extrapolation, or synthetic radar pixels

comparison_note: Existing mission/evidence statistics retain their original local forest references and are not recomputed by this display background.
